name: Asfr's Story
source: The handsome actor Nagasaki Yuito has decided to spend his first day off in a while at a hot spring hotel deep in the mountains, together with his girlfriend Oosato Momoko and her little sister Chika. However, supernatural danger awaits them there...!
translation: 英俊的演员Nagasaki Yuito打算与女友Oosato Momoko及她的妹妹Chika，一起到深山中的温泉旅馆度过久违的假日。然而，超自然的危险正等着他们……！
